How to play

  • You are a Sibure. Eat, drink and stay safe to grow from a tiny Hatchling into a huge Elder with three glowing tails.
  • Hunt: Puffhops hop in the grass, Brookfins swim in the river, Glimmermoths flutter by the flowers and Pebblebeetles crawl near rocks. Big Moonharts are only for Adults. Aim yourself and click to attack (a Sibure pounces). Most prey takes a few bites to bring down, and a Sibure pounce bites harder than a normal bite. Hurt prey runs, and some fight back: Puffhops kick, Pebblebeetles pinch, and a Moonhart kicks hard. Your bite gets stronger as you grow. Sneaking with C lets you get closer.
  • Eat: a catch leaves a carcass. Hold E to eat it bit by bit, or press F to pick it up and carry it. Food goes bad after a few minutes, wherever you leave it.
  • Danger: Duskhawks circle overhead and dive at small foxes in the open: hide under trees or go into a burrow. At night Shadeprowlers hunt. Bite back and they may run, or beat them for a big meal.
  • Drink: walk to the river edge and hold E.
  • Rune stones: the Builders left carved stones all over the world, and ten ruined villages. At night their runes glow: walk up and press E to read one. Press R for your Rune Journal.
  • Burrows: look for big grassy hills with a dark hole at the bottom (there's one right by where you hatch, and the holes glow softly at night). Walk in and follow the tunnel down to a room where you can sleep. Some hills have side tunnels to more rooms, and some have a second way out at the back. Hunters chasing you can follow you in through the tunnels, so a back door can save you.
  • Sleep: press Z in a burrow's room or under a tree. You heal and time passes. The game also saves on its own. Be careful: if your creature dies, it stays dead.
  • Move: WASD or arrows, Shift run, Space jump, X sit. Click the game to look with the mouse; Esc frees it. Scroll to zoom.
  • Preview test key: G gives you a burst of growth so you can see every stage quickly.

Buy an egg from a group. Better groups cost more. You hatch one of the creatures in it at random; if you already have it, you get half your coins back. Earn coins by hunting, fighting off hunters, eating and growing up.
